text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...Hm! What's that?! A rerun of 'Howl at 
the Full Moon!'

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I'm curious... but this is a story I've 
seen many times before. The Boss is 
waiting, so I must return to the Academy—

text_block_list.name: Detective Crab Cream
text_block_list.text:
""So this is their hideout... No time to 
wait for backup, huh.""

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's no use, sir... This must be a 
trap set by the culprit...

text_block_list.name: Detective Crab Cream
text_block_list.text:
""Gah!? An ambush!? Fine by me! I'll take 
you all down!!""

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this legendary footwork coming up 
next...! I can't afford to miss it...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Phenomeno was so hooked on the TV drama 
that she completely forgot all about 
training.
